name: Local AI
author: Timon Röhrbacher
description: Pirate flag for your own models: shows whether a local model (llama.cpp systemd user service) is running and turns them on and off; also lists downloaded .gguf files not set up yet. While a model is loaded, one notification when another app (games included) competes for its GPU/RAM (click it to unload the model; game-watch.py, user service local-ai-game-watch).

barWidget.description: Skull and crossbones while a local model runs; click to turn models on or off.
